newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W.Europe air passenger traffic up 10.1pct in April.
newsitem.headline: W.Europe air passenger traffic up 10.1pct in April.

text.p: Passenger traffic carried on the main western European airlines grew 10.1 percent year-on-year in April, the Association of European Airlines (AEA) said in a statement received on Friday.
Intra-European passenger traffic grew 10.9 percent over the period while flights on long-haul, eastern routes carried nine percent more passengers and North Atlantic ones 8.4 percent.
Load factors also rose, the statement said, up 3.3 percentage points to 71.5 percent with all regions seeing rises of at least two percentage points.
During the same period, freight carriage increased by 2.6 percent to 1,969.3 million revenue freight tonne-kilometres, the AEA statement said.

Member airlines of the AEA, which include all the major flag carriers in western Europe as well as some of the central and east European ones, also posted a slight improvement in flight delays during the first quarter of the year.
Delays of more than 15 minutes hit 17.8 percent of flights during the first quarter compared with 18.4 percent in the last quarter of 1996.
